title: Me and my sister have had mallworld dreams for years
content: I routinely dream that I am in a massive mall that has a somewhat circular layout. I’m going to write down the words and sensations that come to mind, just in case anyone has similar experiences. My sister shares most of these which definitely freaks me out. A massive centerpiece in the middle, plants and water. I’m not really sure what I am in the middle of, per se, but this mall has a layout with something in the center of it. A bikini store staffed by women. A video game store with old titles, movies, and merchandise. Literal pokeballs with functioning pokemon inside them, all lined up in a large display.. A smoke shop with refrigerators and drinks too. There’s a cafeteria that is staffed by people only sometimes. I routinely come here and try and get food. One time I ate a delicious fried chicken sandwich, with very thick and soft bread. I still think about this dream sandwich. It’s all silver, white, and assembly line style. Outside of the mall, also, I literally cannot stop dreaming about flying around this strange coastal beach with cliffs. There are massive towers coming out of the water. They must be 1000 feet tall with dozens of stories. I can climb up them, internally, but I usually encounter challenges doing so. The Rich People neighborhood, anyone? With all white houses and very dark luscious green trees everywhere?
